title: Hours, price, limit
description: How many client hours you really have, what an hour is worth once you count the work outside sessions, how your cycle works, and where one-to-one work ends in money and strength.

units.title: Hours and the price of an hour

objectives.text: Work out the price of every working hour, not only of a session.
Describe your cycle: its length, frequency, and the rules for rescheduling and cancelling.
Find your limit of hours per week and the ceiling of income at your current price.
